3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: Murdock topped our hero damage and bullied two lanes: Gideon died to Mr_Meat31 three times and Revenant twice. Fucking good. The recurring problem was Revenant himself, whose only two kills of the game were both on Murdock. If Revenant shows up next game with Reckoning available, Murdock keeps Buckshot for him: the push-back buys distance and the armor shred makes the duel winnable, instead of handing over the bounty again.
3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.issue: Buckshot overclaim and implied history: the catalog shred is 15% physical armor for 4s, which cannot make a duel winnable. 'Handing over the bounty again' implies both deaths were Reckoning duels, but the feed does not show Reckoning use, and the first death came in a 1-1 skirmish with Gadget credited. 'Bullied two lanes' turns kill credits, several from mid-map skirmishes, into a lane result.
3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.rewrite: Murdock topped our hero damage and kept punishing two enemy laners: Gideon died to Mr_Meat31 three times and Revenant twice. Fucking good. The recurring problem was Revenant himself, whose only two kills of the game were both on Murdock. If Revenant shows up next game with Reckoning available, Murdock keeps Buckshot for him: the push-back buys distance and the armor shred adds damage to the trade, so Revenant has to earn the next one.

3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.quote: Knell applies Rust on hero hits, shredding both armors and giving Riktor part of what it shreds. Patina grants a shield after a stretch without taking damage, which also feeds Transference's shield effects. Resonant Repair heals and grants tenacity whenever Riktor is immobilized; the record does not show how often that happened. That favors a frontline support who trades hits, and Riktor's zero deaths say the durability side held.
3844e5ae-a81b-44a3-b33a-90994711ca01.issue: Overstated item interaction: only Transference's while-shielded bonus clearly applies. Its health return triggers when a shield expires, and Patina's text gives no expiry, only a shield that holds until broken.
